headword: {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}

definitions.gloss: overtime hours; hours of overtime work
definitions.explanation: The number of hours worked beyond regular working hours. A frequent topic in Japanese workplace discussions, especially regarding work-life balance and the legal cap on overtime.

examples.japanese: {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四十時間|よんじゅうじかん}だった。
⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: The law sets an upper limit on monthly overtime hours.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧ (overtime) + ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (hours, time). A central topic in discussions of Japanese working conditions and work-style reform (⟦{働|はたら}き{方改革|かたかいかく}→働き方改革：23313_hatarakikatakaikaku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: have long overtime hours
- {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧: to reduce overtime hours
- {残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧: cap on overtime
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{残業時間|ざんぎょうじかん}: monthly overtime hours

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese labor law caps overtime at 45 hours per month and 360 hours per year in principle, with stricter limits introduced by the 2019 work-style reform. Excessive overtime is associated with the social problem of ⟦{過労死|かろうし}→過労死：14324_karoushi⟧ (death from overwork).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧: overtime work (the activity itself)
- ⟦{残業代|ざんぎょうだい}→残業代：10102_zangyoudai⟧: overtime pay
- ⟦{労働時間|ろうどうじかん}→労働時間：22198_roudoujikan⟧: working hours (total)
